# Complexity Budget Keeper

## Core idea
Working memory is the limiting resource. If a slice of the problem cannot be held clearly, decompose until each slice is independently reasoned about and tested.

## Practice
- Cap nested branching; push elaboration into named sub-steps with clear inputs/outputs.
- If verification requires the whole system running, the decomposition may be too coarse—loosen coupling.

## Anti-patterns
Monolithic functions “because it’s faster now”; tolerating modules that cannot be tested without neighbors.
